fieldRules._comment_override: This block intentionally mirrors the v31.0.0-beta.3 default contact rules — yomifullname / yomi-family / middlename are NOT in this list. Beta.4 added them to defaults; this fixture demonstrates the override-replacement rule from docs/documentation/pii-protection.md ('PII_CONFIG_PATH overrides are not additive'). Q5 of pii-demo-2 captures yomifullname returning raw 'Maria Schmidt' because this override carries forward the pre-beta.4 list. To pick up the new defaults, either remove the contact entry from this config or carry the yomi-family lines into your override.
